review_method: Codex inspected each answer against frozen rubrics and source text; no separate judge API calls. Provisional, not independent human review.
scale: pass = substantially satisfies source/rubric; partial = qualified/incomplete; fail = unsupported or contradictory conclusion. Minor citation omissions noted separately.
